entry.title: Your waist size may reveal health risks BMI misses

entry.summary: We often think about heart disease as something that suddenly happens, like a heart attack, requiring a trip to the emergency room. In reality, cardiovascular disease often develops silently over years or even decades before symptoms appear.

entry.title: Digital strategy helps patients with heart failure to receive proven medication
entry.summary: A registry-based digital strategy that identified untreated patients and invited them to a telephone consultation more than doubled implementation of an effective treatment for heart failure.
